detail.name: _5x_daily_user_counts
detail.description: This model is a secure view that is shared with 5x. The goal of this view is to give insight into how daily users are currently on a 5x managed team account or trial account. This will be used as the source of truth for their billing to their clients as well as us billing them.

body.message: Column-level lineage is not available in this distribution + artifact set.
body.upgrade_path: Run `dbt --use-index <run|build|compile>` with static analysis enabled, in a distribution that ships the column-lineage provider.
